prompt: Red finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy, Found Friend
irony: Red tries to keep the lost puppy by hiding it, but the way to keep a friend is to give it back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Red and Navy cross the sunny park and spot a small shivering puppy by the swings.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Red wants to keep the puppy secret and names it, Navy shares his snack, Green recites breed facts.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares Red to hide the puppy, the tag shows no name and the sky turns grey.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant about the lost puppy and lift it high as pigeons scatter.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Red feeds the puppy chips and hides it under a slide, it yaps and bolts toward ducks.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The puppy drags Red through mud past laughing picnics, leash of jump ropes snaps.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant again, chasing the muddy puppy round the fountain.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White gathers the kids at the big house steps and owns that cuddles heal too.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White decides to wash, feed and walk the puppy back down the street.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: White hands the puppy over with a ribbon as Red waves goodbye.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The kids hum home past the swings as the found puppy trots back for morning games.
